scope: Exercise staged POLYLINE owner identity, source-map lease disposition, injected failure rollback, ledger cleanup, and same-reader retry using generated in-memory frames.

coverage.orphanFirstThenForeignLateParent: PASS: foreign parent rejected; its source-map frame restored; original orphan and owner claim remain valid
coverage.matchingLateParentAdoption: PASS: matching parent staged and adopts the orphan; inverse owner claim released
coverage.terminalization: PASS: pending owner terminalization returns staged bytes and claims to zero
coverage.failureAssertions: PASS: expected source-map frame disposition, empty/valid ledger, inverse claim cleanup, and successful same-reader retry at every injection point

limitations: Synthetic ObjectMap leases are source-location-free and do not establish source-coverage ledger transitions.
The test does not exercise callback publication or a complete actual-DWG reader pipeline.
Top-level unordered-map nodes/buckets and allocator metadata remain outside the modeled staging budget.
This is focused transactional evidence, not a whole-reader memory-bound, thread-safety, or support claim.

planImpact.nextReadyItem: Specify and test the modeled accounting boundary for top-level pending/orphan unordered-map nodes and buckets, then revisit source-location-backed lease/callback evidence if needed; preserve focused-only validation cadence.
